data.cultural_impact: The use of the name Basilea in Christian tradition signifies the reverence and respect given to the Blessed Virgin Mary as the Queen of Heaven, a title that emphasizes her exalted status and role as intercessor and protector. It also connects to the broader Greek cultural heritage of the Western world and the influence of Greek philosophy and language on Christian thought.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian theology, the title Basilea emphasizes the scenario of the Blessed Virgin Mary as a powerful and nurturing figure, a motherly protector and intercessor for her children. It reminds us of her queenship in heaven and her role as the "seat of wisdom," who shapes and guides us on our spiritual journey towards union with God. This name invites us to deepen our devotion to the Blessed Virgin Mary and to seek her intercession and guidance in our lives.
